partners.title: Two European references.
partners.intro: OMAK MOROCCO combines its on-the-ground presence in Casablanca with the know-how of certified European manufacturers: the right brand, the right system, and an installation controlled end to end.

stow.text: European leader in storage and racking for heavy systems: pallet racking, drive-in, dynamic storage, pallet shuttle, mobile, AS/RS, silo, cantilever and mezzanines.

manorga.text: French manufacturer for over 50 years for light, medium and heavy racking, platforms, industrial partitions, handling and safety.

strengths: STOW for high-load, high-bay installations with intensive flows.
MANORGA for light, medium, platform and technical-zone needs.
OMAK handles the study, manufacturing, assembly, inspection and after-sales in Morocco.

rayonnage-lourd.title: Heavy racking
rayonnage-lourd.caption: Pallet racking, high bay, heavy loads.
rayonnage-lourd.headline: The structure built for heavy loads.
rayonnage-lourd.intro: A robust solution to organize pallets, secure aisles and make use of the available height in industrial warehouses.
uses: Industrial back stock with steady flow
Storage of uniform or multi-reference pallets
advantages: Clear read of locations and direct access to pallets
Structure sized to the loads and the usable height
Compatible with protections, mesh, guards and safety accessories
Controlled assembly for durable operation
steps: Dimensions, clear height, loads and forklift flow.
Choice of uprights, beams, levels and protections.

semi-lourd-leger.title: Semi-heavy & light racking
semi-lourd-leger.caption: Boxes, bins, picking and archives.
semi-lourd-leger.headline: Smooth organization for small and medium loads.
semi-lourd-leger.intro: Ideal for boxes, bins, spare parts, archives and preparation zones where readability matters as much as capacity.
uses: Storage of boxes and plastic bins
advantages: Adjustable levels to suit the references
Simple access without heavy equipment
Easy extension as stock evolves
Clean finish for technical or retail zones
steps: Analysis of references, volumes and rotations.
Definition of aisles, heights and levels.
Clean assembly, labelling and shelf adjustment.

cantilever.title: Cantilever
cantilever.caption: Tubes, profiles, panels and long loads.
cantilever.headline: Store lengths without losing safety.
cantilever.intro: Cantilever frees up frontal access for long or bulky loads: tubes, timber, panels, profiles, bars and industrial materials.
uses: Tubes, metal profiles and long bars
Timber panels, sheets and flat materials
Outdoor or covered zones as needed
advantages: Arms sized to the length and weight of the loads
Fast access for forklift or suitable handling
Vertically clear and secure storage
Scalable configurations by level and bay
steps: Length, weight, loading method and rotation.
Choice of columns, arms and spacing.

plateformes-stockage.title: Storage platforms
plateformes-stockage.caption: Mezzanines and extra floor space.
plateformes-stockage.headline: Create usable floor space without moving.
plateformes-stockage.intro: Platforms and mezzanines turn available height into usable floor space to store, prepare, circulate or set up a technical zone.
uses: Industrial mezzanines with stairs and guardrails
advantages: Uses available height without major building work
Structure designed to the operating loads
Integration of stairs, guardrails and pallet access
Ability to phase the project to the budget
steps: Height, columns, access, circulation and constraints.
Layout plan, loads and access safety.

protection-securite.title: Protection & safety
protection-securite.caption: Rack, post and aisle protections.
protection-securite.headline: Protect installations before the incident.
protection-securite.intro: A reliable installation also relies on protections: guards, upright protectors, barriers, stops, signage and separation elements.
uses: Separation of pedestrian and forklift zones
Securing corners, aisles and sensitive zones
advantages: Reduces risks linked to handling impacts
Makes circulation zones clearer
Protects the racking investment over time
Fits new or existing installations
steps: Spotting risk zones and forklift flows.
Choice of protections by impact and use.
Fixing, alignment and final visual check.

accessoires-manutention.title: Accessories & handling
accessoires-manutention.caption: Supports, mesh, dividers and parts.
accessoires-manutention.headline: The right accessories make storage clearer.
accessoires-manutention.intro: Supports, mesh, decking, dividers, bins, shelves and finishing parts complete the racking to fit the real site.
uses: Adapting racking to specific pallets or parcels
Replacing or adding parts on existing installations
advantages: Improves order and the read of locations
Lets you adapt a structure without replacing it all
Makes daily operation easier for teams
Available for new projects or maintenance
steps: Identify the references, formats and constraints.
Check dimensions, loads and existing structure.
Add the accessories and check in use.

etude-conception.title: Study & design
etude-conception.caption: Needs analysis, layout and technical choice.
etude-conception.headline: A clear design before every installation.
etude-conception.intro: OMAK frames your need from the start: dimensions, loads, flows, building constraints and operating goals. The study lets you choose the right structure before launching the assembly.
deliverables: Analysis of dimensions, loads and usable heights
Recommendation of the suitable racking type
advantages: Avoids oversizing or the wrong structure choice
Gives a clear read of the project before approval
Optimizes capacity without blocking handling flows
Prepares a faster and cleaner assembly
process: Collecting field constraints, photos, areas and flows.
Technical choice, levels, aisles, access and safety.
Quote, plan and possible variants within budget.

installation-montage.title: Installation & assembly
installation-montage.caption: Assembly, alignment, anchoring and commissioning.
installation-montage.headline: A clean, clear and safe assembly.
installation-montage.intro: Our teams organize the on-site assembly with a clear method: material receipt, layout, assembly, alignment, anchoring and checking before operation.
deliverables: Organization of the intervention and assembly zones
Assembly of uprights, beams, shelves or platforms
Delivery of an installation ready to operate
advantages: Reduces installation errors and site rework
Guarantees an installation consistent with the approved plan
Improves safety from the first day of use
Limits the impact on the client's activity
process: Schedule, material receipt and zone marking.

controle-installations.title: Installation inspection
controle-installations.caption: Inspection, risk points and recommendations.
controle-installations.headline: Inspect to operate with confidence.
controle-installations.intro: Inspection helps identify visible risks: impacts, deformations, missing protections, anchoring, aisle readability and the general state of the structures.
deliverables: Visual inspection of structures and protections
Identification of sensitive or damaged zones
advantages: Reduces interruptions linked to storage incidents
Helps keep an installation clean and operable
Protects teams, loads and equipment
Gives a clear view of the actions to plan
process: Walkthrough of zones, aisles, uprights and protections.
Proposal for correction, replacement or addition.

service-apres-vente.title: After-sales service
service-apres-vente.caption: Maintenance, parts, adjustments and growth.
service-apres-vente.headline: Useful follow-up after commissioning.
service-apres-vente.intro: After installation, OMAK supports the growth of your storage: adding levels, replacing parts, protections, adapting to new flows and corrective interventions.
deliverables: Adapting the installation to new needs
advantages: Extends the lifespan of installations
Lets you adapt storage without starting over
Ensures a local contact for urgent needs
Makes maintenance and business continuity easier
process: Identifying the need or the problem encountered.
Choice of parts, accessories or suitable correction.
Intervention, inspection and advice for what's next.
